content.text: I'll start by gathering the current state of all three routers. Let me create a diagnostic script.

input.command:
python3 -c "
from netmiko import ConnectHandler

routers = {
    'HQ': '192.168.122.6',
    'Branch1': '192.168.122.5',
    'Branch2': '192.168.122.7',
}

commands = [
    'show interfaces',
    'show ip ospf neighbor',
    'show ip route',
    'show configuration commands | grep ospf',
    'show configuration commands | grep protocols static',
    'show configuration commands | grep interface',
]

for name, ip in routers.items():
    print(f'===== {name} ({ip}) =====')
    dev = ConnectHandler(device_type='vyos', host=ip, username='vyos', password='test')
    for cmd in commands:
        print(f'--- {cmd} ---')
        print(dev.send_command(cmd))
        print()
    dev.disconnect()
"
input.description: Gather diagnostic info from all routers
